text:
sara_ops: Heads up — ap-southeast-1 is running ~18% below expected GPU capacity because 6 units (serials: SNL-3344, SNL-3345, SNL-3346, SNL-3347, SNL-3348, SNL-3349) are still in RMA limbo. We risk hitting Dedicated customer SLOs by Friday.
lee_procurement: Do we have ETA from vendor? last we heard factory lead time 12–16 wks but these are returns/replacements, should be quicker.
mike_logistics: Current RMAs are split across two AWBs and two depots — that’s adding customs hops. If vendor can consolidate to one AWB for APAC, we can do faster import clearance and avoid a weekend dock fee.
alexa_vendor: Sorry for the delay — we've got partial stock at SG depot, but there are paperwork mismatches blocking release (HS code vs customer paperwork). We can do two options: (A) air-expedite partial out (3 units) tomorrow with surcharge, or (B) consolidate all 6 into one sea/air hybrid next-week window (cheaper, 7–9 days).
sara_ops: Option A would help the cluster immediately. What's the surcharge and lead time on paperwork fix? also do we need firmware swap or thermal sensor reseal at depot?
alexa_vendor: Surcharge is 8% of unit value for air with immediate customs brokerage. Paperwork fix ETA 24–48h if we supply missing invoice fields and HS subcode. No firmware reseal required for these RMAs — depot confirms unit health checks passed, issue marked as "connector seating".
lee_procurement: Can vendor absorb part of the surcharge? We're looking at SLA credits if we miss 99.9% latency windows. If vendor covers 50% surcharge, procurement can sign off.
alexa_vendor: We can cover 30% of expedite surcharge and waive depot handling fee if Redwood covers the rest and signs consolidated AWB release.
mike_logistics: If we consolidate, give me one AWB and our customs broker will pre-clear under HS 8473.30. Forecasted dock fee saved: ~$2.4k. If vendor pays 30% and we pay 70%, net expedite cost = vendor_quoted * 0.7 - savings.
sara_ops: Ok do it for 3 units (air) — prioritize SNL-3344/3345/3346. Leave the other 3 for consolidated next-week sea/air. mike: can you confirm broker details?
mike_logistics: Confirmed. Broker: PacificClear APAC (acct: REDWOOD-PAC). Need manifest in this format:
```
AWB: TBD123456789
Units: 3
Serials: SNL-3344,SNL-3345,SNL-3346
HS: 8473.30
Declared value: USD 64,500
```
Provide invoice copy and vendor's export declaration and they can pre-clear within 12h.
alexa_vendor: I'll push manifest & invoice by EOD. We'll mark the 3 as 'air-partial' and the rest 'hold-consolidate'.
sara_ops: rma-bot, did we create temporary capacity plan to avoid SLOs if shipment slips 48h?
rma-bot: AUTO: temp loaner pool request created: LN-POOL-APAC-2026-03, 3 units reserved; ETA to deploy if needed: 4h after approval.
lee_procurement: Approving vendor cover at 30% and Redwood paying remaining 70% for expedite. Please attach a quick PO amendment.
alexa_vendor: Received. PO amendment will be attached to the AWB email. We'll send AWB # and tracking once booked.
mike_logistics: Once AWB is live I'll trigger broker pre-clear and coordinate last-mile. If customs hits additional duty, we'll flag immediately and request duty defer via vendor credit note.
sara_ops: Thanks — action items: alexa send manifest/invoice by EOD, mike pre-clear on AWB, rma-bot keep LN-POOL hot until units inbound. If anything slips beyond 48h we switch all 6 to loaners. :thumbsup:
lee_procurement: noted, will log the PO amendment and tax treatment for finance.
alexa_vendor: Will follow up in thread with AWB and booking ref.
sara_ops: closing loop — please keep replies short here so we can escalate if needed.
